snippet.title: Hubert - Announce Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/764930/Hubert/

Step into the paws of a loyal shepherd dog in this atmospheric third-person adventure. Track scents, herd sheep, and navigate the rugged northern wilderness. Face rough weather, natural predators, and changing times as you help your shepherd find a way south before winter tightens its grip.
